description: This file defines a middleware function for Express.js that authenticates requests using JSON Web Tokens (JWT). It verifies the 'Authorization' header for a Bearer token, validates the token, and attaches the decoded user payload to the request object before passing control to the next middleware. If verification fails, it responds with a 401 Unauthorized error.

methods.name: authenticateJWT(req, res, next)
methods.description: Middleware function that authenticates incoming requests using JWT tokens from the Authorization header.
